title: Unit 26 Consolidation: Pluralism, Heritage & Minority Perspectives

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can master reciprocal case-marked phrases and postpositions (egymás iránt, egymással szemben, egymás mellett)
I can systematically apply distributive morphology with -onként/-enként/-önként across sociological contexts
I can articulate nuanced positions on cultural autonomy, historical testimony, and inter-ethnic bridge-building
